**Level-up flow**

**When offered:** Worker computes `shouldLevelUp(character)` (`worker/src/services/character.ts:159`) — `xp >= XP_THRESHOLDS[level]` and `level < 10` (thresholds: 0,300,900,2700,6500,14000,23000,34000,48000,64000). Returned as `canLevelUp` by `POST /api/action` and `POST /api/combat/resolve`. Frontend shows a banner (`character-sheet.component.html:66`) and an ability picker (`game-console.component.html:19-28`).

**Endpoint call:** User picks an ability → `game-console.component.ts:183` `levelUp(key)` → `GameApiService.levelUp(sessionId, characterId, abilityChoice)` (`game-api.service.ts:74`) → `POST /api/levelup` (`worker/src/routes/levelup.ts:10`). Ability choice must be one of str/dex/con/int/wis/cha; returns 400 if `!shouldLevelUp`.

**Character changes** (`services/character.ts:133` `levelUp`):
- `level` +1
- HP gain = `roll(class hit die) + CON mod`, added to both `max_hp` and current HP (hit dice: Fighter/Ranger d10, Rogue/Cleric/Bard d8, Wizard d6)
- Chosen ability score +2 (no cap at 20; AC unchanged)

**Response/UI:** `routes/levelup.ts:39-50` adds flavor narrative (usually fallback text per bug B-03), a `system` log row, and a DM history turn; frontend (`game-console.component.ts:187-194`) updates character state, sets `canLevelUp` false, posts a system message, updates campaign slot level. One level gained per call — multi-level XP jumps require repeated calls.
